summary_md: **B. Elliott Baker ([@spiritform](https://x.com/spiritform/status/2115674848630591970))** submits **Hero's Journey** to the Open Source Higgsfield Challenge, a ComfyUI-based generative monomyth experience with a demo video and the spiritform/herosjourney repo. Follow-ups show it built with Claude Code and the Comfy MCP, then add a Flux 3 bounding-box edit mode, an optional Qwen Image Edit 2.1 model for character sheets in the Take Shape step, Flux 3 klein, and MiniMax H3 plus LTX image-to-video. Later posts wire in the new open-weight Pika H3 FLEX for the Set in Motion step and reveal that the first challenge week went into a more complex idea, LatentLab, shelved in favour of something plug-and-play, with a LatentLab clip made in Pika H3 FLEX.
